mapper.select:
SELECT id, name, color, item_type, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_schedule_category
AND status = 1
AND (item_type = #{itemType} OR item_type = 'ALL')
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_schedule_category (name, color, item_type, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{color}, #{itemType}, #{sortOrder}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_schedule_category SET name = #{name}, color = #{color}, item_type = #{itemType}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
